text: Hey! I have tons of good stuff.\nI’ll share some with you!

Listen. I’ll give you some tips about Fossils.\c
The professor on Route 6 will restore Fossils
for you.\c
If you want to collect different Fossils, go to
the Wild Area. Search for them by yourself or
ask the Digging Duo!
Training on the mountain...\nWhat a stoic Black Belt you are!
